title: Insights in the Antimicrobial Potential of the Natural Nisin Variant Nisin H.

materials_exhausted.notes: XML/PDF/OA package/Data_Sheet_1.PDF, landed supplementary HTML/bin assets, and linked DBAASP/merged sequence/experiment rows were checked for owner-layer rework. No missing local source blocks worker-4/6 adjudication.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP linked assay/experiment/literature rows were reconciled against primary Tables 2/3, Figure 1, Table 1, and merged sequence rows. IC50 rows are verified after explicit µM-to-nM conversion; one Nisin H VRE MIC value remains source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity rows now preserve Table 2 IC50 values in nM and Table 3 MIC values in µM with entity, target strain, and locators. No host toxicity endpoint is reported in local materials.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism record distinguishes direct SYTOX membrane permeabilization evidence from phenotypic resistance/immunity context and modification context; no unsupported direct binding/transport claim is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_4_publication_grade: The framework-only ticket is closed after source-reviewed worker-4/6 repair. Remaining uncertainty is caution-grade and explicitly preserved, with no open blocking rework target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DBAASP assay/experiment rows for DBAASPR_21186 against Enterococcus faecalis ATCC 51299 carry 0.56 µM, while primary Table 3 carries 1.56 µM; final status is source_conflict, not source_verified.
Checked local XML/PDF/Data Sheet materials do not provide host toxicity or hemolysis endpoints; no such values were fabricated.

summary: Source-reviewed worker-4/6 repair reconciled the DBAASP-linked nisin H and F1I records with the primary paper tables, replaced framework-only final review with paper-specific adjudication, and leaves the paper accepted with cautions because one database MIC value conflicts with the primary table while no blocking local-material gap remains.
